brief: The painted sill exists at exactly one camera position. drawSill(g) runs inside drawOurSide and is therefore baked into the GROUND CACHE, while agents and overlays sort after it — so at Courtyard, Street, Plaza and Far bank there is no sill at all and the bottom band fills with live content drawn over where it should be (measured max luma 221 at Courtyard, 192 at Plaza, 112 at Street, against the painted surface's mean of ~13). Four of the five things the #where button does are broken in the same way, and #where is the town's most-used offer. Give every quarter its sill. Note that b110 lands before you and may have changed what the near roof shows at the sill line — re-read drawSill and nearHidden on HEAD before pricing anything.
successLooksLike: A screenshot at each of the five camera positions shows the same painted sill across the bottom, with nothing living drawn on top of it, at 1200x720, 1600x950 and 390x844.
avoid: Do not solve it by moving drawSill out of the cache and repainting it live every frame without pricing that — it is a 7-stop gradient plus 22 grain runs plus 9 scuffs plus cast shadows, and drawGround's own spread is 0.90 ms. If you do lift it out, measure with frame-cost.mjs, not perf.mjs. And a quarter's share sets s from WIDTH alone, so sillTop() is not where you think it is in a zoomed frame — price the rows with project() on each target frame.
